description: Displays a list of property changes in a before/after diff format, showing old values with strikethrough and new values highlighted, connected by an arrow icon. Since KG-008 both values paint their semantic TEXT tones (--tm-color-success-text / --tm-color-danger-text, WCAG AA on the row surface) and each value carries a localized screen-reader prefix (TmChangeDiff_PreviousValue / TmChangeDiff_NewValue) in a visually hidden span — the visible run is aria-hidden so a reader hears "Previous value: X, New value: Y" exactly once.

parameters.name: Changes
parameters.description: List of property changes to display.

examples.title: Display property changes
examples.code:
<TmChangeDiff Changes="@(new List<TmChangeInfo>
{
    new() { Property = "Status", OldValue = "Draft", NewValue = "Published" },
    new() { Property = "Title", OldValue = "Old Title", NewValue = "New Title" }
})" />
